name: Monchique Resort & Spa
description:
Surrounded by nature and views of the Algarve coast, Monchique Resort & Spa is located in the Serra de Monchique and features restaurants, 2 outdoor pools and a variety of Spa experiences. The resort features a program of activities that guests may enjoy for free.

The resort’s luxurious suites are elegant and beautifully appointed, offering a separate bedroom, large living room, two bathrooms and a balcony or terrace with outdoor furniture and some with stunning views over the mountains and coastline. Free of charge WiFi is available in all areas.

Each of the restaurants at the Monchique Resort & Spa offers a unique gastronomic experience. From award-winning fine dining through Neapolitan pizzeria and themed international and national buffet. The Mezzanine cocktail bar often has live entertainment (during high season) and the bars serve a variety of drinks and light snacks.

The Sensorial Spa features sauna, steam room, aromatherapy, an indoor heated pool (25€ per 2 hours for adult - children under 16 years old are not allowed) relaxation rooms, treatment rooms, we recommend to book it prior arrival directly with the Spa Team. 24-hour open Gym. Personalized training sessions can be booked, for a surcharge. Children between 5 and 12 years old are welcome at the on-site Kids Club available every day (during high season). Guests may book activities like jeep safaris, hiking, standup paddle and mountain biking with an additional fee.

The hotel is a 60-minute drive from Faro International Airport. It is only a 20-minute drive away from several beaches in the Portimão area, and a 15-minute drive away from the nearest golf course.

name: Vila Relaxmountain B&B
dest_name: São Bartolomeu de Messines, Algarve, Portugal
description:
Elegant Accommodations: Vila Relaxmountain B&B in São Bartolomeu de Messines offers a recently renovated 5-star experience with a garden, terrace, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi, air-conditioning, and private bathrooms with modern amenities.

Comfortable Amenities: The property features a lounge, coffee shop, outdoor seating area, family rooms, and bicycle parking. Additional amenities include a balcony, work desk, and soundproofed rooms, ensuring a relaxing and comfortable stay.

Delicious Breakfast: A buffet breakfast is served daily, offering warm dishes, fresh pastries, cheese, fruits, and juice. Guests appreciate the variety and quality of the breakfast offerings.

Prime Location: Located 5.6 mi from Tunes Train Station, 8.1 mi from Algarve Shopping Center, and 11 mi from Albufeira Old Town Square, the B&B provides easy access to local attractions. Faro Airport is 33 mi away. Highly rated for its swimming pool, host, and garden.

name: Wyndham Grand Algarve
description:
The Wyndham Grand Algarve is located in one of Portugal’s largest golf resorts and surrounded by the tranquility of Ria Formosa Nature Park. This recently renovated All-suite 5-Star hotel includes an adults only Spa and offers well-appointed accommodations, with all the mod cons.

Each Suite is creatively designed with focus on comfort and functionality. All suites boast furnished living rooms and balconies with views of landscaped gardens. The spacious Suites come equipped with HD TVs, kitchen supplies and the added comfort of five-star services and amenities. Free Wi-Fi is provided.

Guests can enjoy Breakfast at CARAVELA Restaurant overlooking the pool. The hotel provides a delicious menu focused on healthy signature dishes, salads, pizzas and burgers on the poolside outdoor terrace of the OÁSIS Poolside Café, where cool drinks and refreshing cocktails are served while guests indulge in the Algarve sun.
With a bistro chic concept, Wyndham Grand Algarve’s restaurant XXL Quinta do Lago by Olivier, overlooks the hotel gardens, and serves a dinner menu that exposes the union between respect for Portuguese cuisine traditions and the irreverence of restaurateur Olivier da Costa.
At the GRAND Bar & Lounge guests can have tasty bites while exploring the cocktails menu while listening to live music.

The GRAND Spa is available for adults only, offering a jacuzzi, sauna and offers relaxing massages and body treatments with Cinq Mondes signature.
Wyndham Grand Algarve also has a fully equipped GYM overlooking the hotel gardens.

Located in the heart of Quinta do Lago, Wyndham Grand Algarve is 20 minutes away from Faro International Airport and 2 hours away from Lisbon or Seville.
Nearby leisure activities include golf, beach, water sports, tennis, bike rides, horse riding and bird watching. Free private parking is available on site.
